selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent spatial dependency chain: the player must first locate a spruce pressure plate that activates a redstone mechanism opening access to an acacia door. Mining (breaking) the acacia door then reveals a hidden room containing a stone brick slab. This creates a multi-hop exploration puzzle where each step gates the next, requiring observation, interaction, and navigation — all verifiable without deep Minecraft domain knowledge.

edges.reason: Stepping on the spruce pressure plate triggers a redstone mechanism that opens the wall/passage revealing the acacia door
Breaking the acacia door grants entry to the sealed room where the stone brick slab is placed on the floor

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the spruce pressure plate at relative (0, 0, 5) and face toward it. The pressure plate is on the floor on an oak plank strip, so the player needs to be within viewing distance and looking in its direction. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target' appropriately.

Uses inventory_has because mining/breaking an acacia door causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory so having at least 1 acacia_door confirms the door was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate into the back room (behind the acacia door at z=10) and face toward the stone brick slab floor. Target is the center of the slab area at (0, -1, 14). The player must be within 16 blocks and facing the target, which naturally requires entering the back room since the dividing wall blocks line-of-sight from the front corridor.

scene_description: A straight stone brick corridor (7 blocks wide, 16 blocks long) with three sequential objectives. The player spawns at the entrance facing into the corridor. First, an oak plank strip on the floor at z=5 holds a spruce pressure plate. A dividing wall at z=10 contains an acacia door. Behind the door is a back room (z=11-17) with a stone brick slab floor, lit by glowstone.
task_text: Enter the stone brick corridor. First, find the spruce pressure plate on the floor. Then mine the acacia door to access the back room. Finally, find the stone brick slabs on the floor of the back room.
design_notes: Corridor spans x:[-3,3], z:[3,18]. Player spawns at (0,0,0) facing +Z. Entrance: 2-block-wide opening at z=3. Pressure plate at (0,0,5) on oak plank strip at y=-1. Dividing wall at z=10 with acacia door at (0,0-1,10). Back room z=11-17 with stone_brick_slab floor at y=-1. Glowstone ceiling lights at y=3 in both sections. The corridor is 5 interior blocks wide and well-lit throughout.
